name: linear-agent-lock-lifecycle

steps.name: sync-session
steps.gate: ghostCount for this agent's lane == 0 before claiming a new issue

steps.name: claim
post: agent-lock family labels applied (agent-lock, agent:<agent>, status:agent-working, lock:claimed)

steps.name: work
rules: mirror file claims in AI-Agent-Sync Agent-State/<agent>.md
never leave mid-flight edit to a file another agent has claimed

post: agent-lock family stripped (resolved by UUID, id matches /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i, never 'undefined')
same-day vault closeout note written with duration_m + prevention_note
agent-lock family stripped (resolved by UUID; full label-id regression check)

regression_test: labelIdIsUuid — for lock-family labels, require id to match /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i; query shape issue(id: $id) { labels { nodes { id name } } } with $id: String!.
